works.body:
Greetings!

I would like to request a drawing about my original characters, Karamelle and Kayen:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LvqmzITqgNiQqSyvYTMaxWWhqaoGfq06?usp=sharing

- Karamelle is a priestess serving the Fertility Goddess. Half-elf woman. Looks physically 35 years old. Cheerful, kind and hardworking. Buxom body. Not married and without children yet.
- Kayen is a young adventurer. Former slave trained to become a gladiator. Serious and fierce, but socially awkward. Sexually inexperienced. He is Karamelle's future husband. Kayen wears a pauldron with his black and red outfit.

Situation:
Karamelle having her skirt lifted up by the wind, much to her embarrassment. Karamelle doesn't wear any panties at all. Kayen, who was just behind Karamelle, gets a full view of her bare ass. Kayen gets an erection as a result.

If possible, I would like a variation where Karamelle sticks her tongue out in a playful manner. She is aware of the effect her body has on young boys.

Thanks!
